description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'UserServiceTest' for testing the 'UserService' class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, helper methods, and multiple test cases verifying user authentication, password management, and user role logic.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the functionality of the UserService class, including user management, password validation, and user role handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of UserService before each test.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Creates and returns a UserRole object with preset properties for use in tests.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserNoPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a system user without changing the password, ensuring the user object is returned correctly.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserWithPasswordChange
methods.description: Verifies password hashing when a password change is detected during user save operation.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordUserNotFound
methods.description: Checks that the method returns false when the user is not found in the database.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordTrue
methods.description: Ensures that the correct current password matches the stored hashed password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordWithNullPassword
methods.description: Tests behavior when the user's stored password is null.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordOldHash
methods.description: Verifies that older MD5 password hashes are correctly authenticated.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordFalse
methods.description: Confirms that an incorrect password does not authenticate.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsUserNotFound
methods.description: Checks that credential retrieval returns null when user does not exist.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsValidPassword
methods.description: Verifies successful credential validation with correct password.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsOldHash
methods.description: Ensures that old MD5 hashes are upgraded to new hashed passwords upon login.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvalidPassword
methods.description: Checks that invalid passwords result in null credentials.

methods.name: testGetUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of user IDs that cannot be deleted based on user roles.
